title: novelty.audit_ready (v1)
description: NoveltyAuditAgent has finished auditing the reinterpreted ResearchSpec against prior literature and frozen a NoveltyAuditReport into the Research Store (see agents/novelty_audit_agent/data-contracts/novelty_audit_report.schema.yaml).
